snippet.title: Hyperspace Neptunia: Unlimited | Announcement Trailer | PS4, PS5, NSW, NSW2, Steam®
snippet.description:
ESRB: RP
ESRB Descriptors: RP

The next canonical release of the Neptunia franchise, Hyperspace Neptunia: Unlimited, launches in 2027 for the PlayStation®4, PlayStation®5, Nintendo Switch™, Nintendo Switch™ 2, and Steam®! 

【Official Website】
https://ifi.games/neptuniaunlimited

【Wishlist on Steam】
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5353890/Hyperspace_Neptunia_Unlimited/

【Wishlist the Standard Edition】
https://ifi.store/products/neptunia-unlimited-se

【Wishlist the Limited Edition】
https://ifi.store/products/neptunia-unlimited-le

【About Hyperspace Neptunia: Unlimited】
When the first asteroid struck, the end of the world followed. As despair consumed all, only the Goddess Neptune was left behind in a white void. 

A mysterious voice began to guide her, and she discovered numbers etched upon her cheek. 

This mark signaled Neptune's new challenge against Doomsday. 

She activated a "retry," and thus began her loop of endings and beginnings. 

Neptune encounters new allies and enemies and must overcome countless defeats as she and her friends confront the true Doomsday. 

【Key Features 】
With all this space, a Goddess Needs the Ability of Flight! – A whole new adventure has opened up for the Goddesses where dungeons are more expansive than ever! Goddesses can seamlessly switch from running to flight to explore new heights. Explore waterways, rooftops, and other crevices to duke it out with enemies and even find special items that can help you along the way. 

Goddesses Take the Skies in Battle – Even in battle, Goddesses can switch to their Goddess Forms to attack from above. With new EXE Drive animations, a rehauled combo system, and massive world bosses, the Goddesses will need all the room possible to take down their foes. 

Customization to the MAX! – Previous Neptunia titles offered a variety of customizable hijinks for all the characters, but this time, we’ve taken it up a notch! Freely change your favorite Goddesses' colors, attach fun accessories wherever you like (including the size, positioning, and color), strengthen Processor Unit equipment found in dungeons that boost stats, and craft with the classic Disc Make that helps Goddesses achieve new abilities. Did we forget to mention that you can change Purple Heart’s wings orange!? 

New Flavors with the Same Nep Wackiness – The renowned Neptunia illustrator, Tsunako, is back and envisions the world of Neptunia once again with brand new illustrations, as well as newly designed Goddesses that old fans and new will love!

#neptunia
